versions.changelog:
## [0.26.19.3] - 2026-09-21

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Let user data actions materialize a search result (#227)
- Keep downloads working when the token is an API key (#234)
- Leave the library's own episodes and seasons out of the tree clean-up (#235)
- Keep the addon stream URL out of client-facing responses (#236)
- Materialize a search result opened with an API key (#237)
- Purge collections the catalog import created (#239)
- Mark the whole series when a marks as played action materializes a series (#240)
- Fallback to addon ids when imdb and tmdb are missing (#238)

## [0.26.19.2] - 2026-09-20

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Resolve a TMDB id from the imdb id so digital release dates are fetched again
- Stop the release buffer working backwards
- Filter unreleased items out of a non-recursive listing too
- Apply the unreleased filter to the search suggestions
- Stop the addon search offering films the library hides
- Take the TMDB id the addon reports before asking TMDB for it
- Keep the other item types in a search the addon answers (#232)
- Ask the meta addon for every id a result carries (#231)

## [0.26.19.1] - 2026-09-19

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Keep native items listed when filtering unreleased items (#222)
- Search hardening (#219)
- Ignore non-supported library options (#221)
- Keep debrid keys and addon config out of the logs (#220)
- Stop writing EndDate on native items (#223)
- Keep extended local series trees through a library scan (#224)

## [0.26.19.0] - 2026-09-16

- Jellyfin 12.1 support (based on native versions) (#218)
